effects.description: Coalesce edits at 0/30/80 ms into the latest save at 200 ms while preserving the active navigation projection.
A later burst receives its own quiet interval after the first has completed.
Closing preserves accepted text before return and clears projection without adding history.
Switch saves the departing document and commits one new visit in body, outline and history.
Close and same-document reopen have distinct visit identity and retain each committed visit exactly once.
A departure save selects C during outer select B; the caller must not overwrite C outline or append superseded B history.
A departure save closes during outer select B; both body and projection stay closed and B never enters history.
Both outer and nested requests select B, but only the newer B visit belongs in outline/history.
Outer close flushes A and a save integration selects C; caller clear after editor.close must not erase C.
Timer-fired save selects B synchronously; ordinary nested navigation commits one visit and detaches A badge.
A save integration queues another edit in the active visit and the new batch remains live.
Preview keeps one coherent 40 ms interval or the independently authorized 120 ms interval.
Hiding transient preview discards pending work instead of flushing it.
A hidden preview can schedule a fresh query under its unchanged cancellation policy.
